visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man with a short beard, wearing a brown jumpsuit and a tan cap, walks briskly toward the camera in an outdoor setting. Behind him is a tall, dark gray textured wall and large tropical-style green leaves in a white planter. He waves his hand and speaks with active facial expressions. (2) The scene cuts to a close-up of a worker's hand using a metal trowel to spread gray adhesive onto a wall. Then it cuts back to the man in the brown jumpsuit, who is now holding a black thermos and pointing while standing still against the same wall. (3) Quick cuts show old, weathered buildings with sections of tiles missing, exposing red brick beneath. A construction worker in a yellow hard hat and safety glasses is shown briefly, working on a wall with white tiles. (4) Back to the man outside; he continues to explain things, gesturing with his hands. Then a low-angle shot shows a modern glass skyscraper reflecting a bright, hazy sun in a blue sky with some clouds. (5) Close-up shots of water droplets resting on a light-colored tile surface are shown, demonstrating surface tension. This is followed by a shot of broken concrete and tile debris piled on the ground. (6) The man is shown unzipping his jumpsuit to reveal a large, square light-colored tile hidden inside. He holds it up to the camera, showcasing its textured pattern. He then touches different samples of porcelain, stone, and ceramic tiles. (7) Shots of a tall modern apartment building with white and dark brown tile sections are shown. The man is then seen sitting in a light-colored modern armchair in an indoor setting with warm lighting and decorative objects, concluding his talk.

It transitions from identified problems to scientific explanations and concludes by promoting Champion Building Materials as a reliable choice meeting national standards.
